podcast.title: Later Career Highlights
podcast.body: Mick Gallagher later became the keyboard player for Ian Dury and the Blockheads and also contributed to several tracks by The Clash. He currently tours the UK as a member of The Animals and Friends. "Gallagher would later go on to be the keyboard player with Ian Jury and the blockheads, as well as playing on several tracks by the clash."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Temporary Animals Keyboardist
podcast.body: Mick Gallagher briefly filled in as The Animals' keyboard player for a couple of weeks in April 1965, following Alan Price's sudden departure, before Dave Rowberry became the permanent replacement. "The group quickly rushed to find a filling keyboard player for the tour, and 19-year-old Mick Gallagher was with them for a couple of weeks"
